summary: Synlogic, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, filed an 8-K regarding its entry into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger on July 28, 2026, with Caldera Therapeutics, Inc., and related entities (Parent and Merger Subs). The transaction involves two mergers: Synlogic and Caldera will each merge into subsidiaries of a newly formed parent, with Synlogic and Caldera surviving as wholly owned subsidiaries. The deal is intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization. Each outstanding share of Synlogic common stock will convert into shares of Parent common stock based on an exchange ratio set forth in the merger agreement. The filing does not specify the exchange ratio, price per share, or premium. Shareholders have appraisal rights. The structure combines two private companies under a new public parent, effectively an acquisition of Synlogic by the controlling entity. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory approvals; the key unknown is the exchange ratio and resulting ownership split.
